## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what the proposed capability or enhancement is.

## Core Principle Check
- [ ] This proposal **DOES NOT** require or introduce Large Language Models (LLMs) or external AI APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, etc.).
- [ ] This proposal adheres to deterministic algorithms, local NLP, knowledge graphs, or rule-based reasoning.
- [ ] This capability operates offline / local-first with zero external cloud dependencies.

## Target Component
- [ ] Custom NLP Engine (Tokenization, Stemming, Lemmatization, Spelling, Intent Detection)
- [ ] Knowledge Engine & BM25 Inverted Index
- [ ] Knowledge Graph & Deductive Reasoning
- [ ] Safe Arithmetic & Unit Converter
- [ ] Self-Learning & Feedback Optimization
- [ ] Admin Dashboard & Curation Workflow
- [ ] UI / Front-end Experience

## Proposed Implementation Details
Describe how the deterministic logic, data structure, or algorithm should be designed.
